name: Islam
desc: The Quran, the pillars, Ramadan and Hajj, the Prophet's life and early Islamic history.

Five

The Quran

Mecca

Five

Medina

Jibril (Gabriel)

Iqra' (Read)

Which surah, often read on Fridays, tells the story of the People of the Cave?

Into how many parts (juz') is the Quran divided?
